name: C•ko•fn•ta•C
source:
A troubled illustrator runs away from home.

A lonely fan takes her under her wing.

From there, it’s all downhill.

A visual novel about responsibility, arrested adolescence, and the mortifying ordeal of being (un)known.

[From [url=https://madocactus.itch.io/sychophantasy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位陷入困境的插画家离家出走。

一位孤独的粉丝将她庇护在自己的羽翼之下。

从那里开始，一切都是下坡路。

一部关于责任、青春期停滞以及不为人所知的痛苦折磨的视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://madocactus.itch.io/sychophantasy]itch.io[/url]]
